notes:
- Switch to avatars in favourites 2-6 without VRC+ (sign in to VRChat on the Accounts page)
- Saybox says when an avatar switch worked, and how long it took
- Say 'take me to <world>' or 'random world' to get an invite there
- Say 'previous instance' to go back to the instance you were in before
- Say 'where is my friend <name>' (offline friends too: when they were last on) or 'join <friend>'
